body.statement: Under consistency, conditional exchangeability, and overlap, \(\mu_a(x)\) is a version of \(\mathbb E_P[Y_a\mid X=x]\) for \(a\in\{0,1\}\). Hölder continuity makes \(\tau\) the unique continuous representative of \(x\mapsto\mathbb E_P[Y_1-Y_0\mid X=x]\), so \(\theta(P)=\tau_P(x_0)\) is identified.
body.justification: The continuous-version convention makes a pointwise causal effect well defined at a covariate value having probability zero.
body.gap: Kennedy et al. use the same identifying assumptions; this lemma records the representative needed by the private pointwise problem.
body.consumer: It gives the private risk a causal rather than merely regression-functional interpretation.
